description: Session-scoped operator control to move existing work items to another authored state via CLI and HTTP, with canonical WORK_STATE_CHANGE events, engine marking updates, projections, replay persistence, and pause-safe behavior.

context.customerAsk: Add session-scoped manual work migration: you work move <work-id> <state-name>, matching HTTP API, WORK_STATE_CHANGE events, engine marking, CLI, dashboard replay projection, and record/replay. Reject in-flight dispatches; allow moves while paused; retain failure history when leaving FAILED; no delete or auto-unfail.
context.problem: After failures or cascading dependency failure, work can sit in FAILED or blocked states with no operator ingress to relocate tokens. Marking may be correct while the event stream, replay artifacts, and dashboard stay stale because moves lack canonical FactoryEvent recording.
context.solution: Implement a full vertical slice: OpenAPI contract and move routes, pause-safe engine control path applying MutationMove, RecordWorkStateChange with SSE fanout, HTTP and CLI ingress with requestId idempotency (409 on replay), backend and UI projections, replay persistence, pause tick audit, functional recovery test, and maintainer docs after ship.

acceptanceCriteria: POST /work/{id}/move and session-scoped variant move work to a named authored state and return work at the new position
you work move mirrors HTTP with --session and human/json output showing previous and new state
Move is rejected when work is in ActiveDispatches; duplicate requestId returns 409 without second mutation
Each successful operator move emits one WORK_STATE_CHANGE (source api or cli) on SSE and in replay artifacts
Operator move succeeds while factory is PAUSED; automatic subsystem ticks do not advance marking while paused
Dashboard timeline at a later tick shows the work token in the target place after a manual move
Typecheck, lint, and make verify-pr pass (quality gate)
